scientific_integrity: Analytical proof given; finite high-precision diagnostics are supplemental and do not replace proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific factorial-weighted Hilbert-space shift and explicit square-zero rank-one direction; fixed nonzero complex couplings. Remainder constants need not be uniform as coupling tends to zero. Completeness of eigenvectors and generalizations to other weights are not claimed. Older equivalent transcendental spectral calculations could affect priority.
title: Exceptional-point lattice and sharp eigenvalue counting for a nilpotent rank-one factorial-shift perturbation
